_meta: G7.1 CNOPS71 (docs/G71_SCOPE.md J6, roster 5A Q9 site A approved by ORCH 2026-11-09): the trauma + decon hospital, two 4x4 blocks astride the gate approach road north of the CN facility (ORCH decision 2026-11-22, PROVISIONAL, to the owner: no free 6x6 inside the rings after the facility fill; content/g71_lp/lp_base_cnops.json): the trauma block (hospital: true = Medical evacuation delivers there, def-driven, no hard-coded building; hospital71: true = Hospital71 wards) and the ward wing. Art: tools/art/g71_cn.gd -> assets/art/g71_cn. Every number PROVISIONAL. Units (CNOPS71-7): the hospital fleet, 2 medevac helicopters + 2 drone ambulances (art: same generator, derived from the G5 transport gunship / G6 UGV sheets).

a_g71_hospital.name: Trauma Hospital
a_g71_hospital._note: J6 trauma block: triage bay, surgery theatres (2), ICU (4), rooftop medevac pad (Pads71 kind hospital, next step). Last Protocol starting base only (buildable false). PROVISIONAL.

a_g71_hospital_wing.name: Hospital Ward Wing
a_g71_hospital_wing._note: J6 ward wing: recovery ward (12), decon showers + scan gate, sealed quarantine ward (2), prosthetics bay (1). PROVISIONAL.

a_g71_medevac_heli.name: Medevac Helicopter
a_g71_medevac_heli._note: J6 medevac helicopter (CNOPS71-7): no 'aircraft' key, so Air leaves it alone; it flies straight (air_low skips nav) on Medical auto evac and holds over the hospital roof pad (Hospital71._fleet). LP starting base only, not trainable. Count 2, speed, slots PROVISIONAL.

a_g71_drone_ambulance.name: Drone Ambulance
a_g71_drone_ambulance._note: J6 fast tracked drone ambulance (CNOPS71-7): pulls own wounded off the field on Medical auto evac and parks at the trauma block door (Hospital71._fleet). LP starting base only. Count 2, speed, slots PROVISIONAL.
